answer: Juniper-rooted whisper probation: a newcomer posts a 12 POA bond and spends six epochs on probation, doing one useful job per epoch that a different stranger whisper-verifies by staking 2 POA on its truth. Each clean epoch thaws 2 POA back, glacier-slow; a fake that quits early forfeits the rest. The nth identity from one wallet posts 12n POA and needs n different strangers per epoch, so the 1st fake risks 12 while the 10th risks 120.
